summary.text: Anthony Bellmon is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 203 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Bellmon previously worked in Democratic campaign and congressional office roles.

paragraphs.text: Anthony Bellmon earned a B.A. in political science from George Washington University in 2012.

His career experience includes working as political director for the Brendan Boyle campaign for the U.S. House, as a senior advisor in Boyle's congressional office, and as regional political director for southeastern Pennsylvania for Joe Biden's 2020 presidential campaign.

In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Children and Youth, Urban Affairs and Housing, Tourism and Recreational Development, and Transportation committees, and was subcommittee chair on Highways for the Transportation Committee.
